# porch_invite (Resource)

Invites an email address to a tenant (needs `invite:manage`). The invitation is accepted when someone signs in with a matching verified upstream email. Invitations cannot be edited; changes replace them. Import with `<tenant>/<invite_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Accepted when someone signs in with a matching verified upstream email.
resource "porch_invite" "grandma" {
  tenant        = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  email         = "grandma@example.com"
  valid_seconds = 1209600 # 14 days
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Invited email address (lowercase). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `tenant` (String) ID or slug of the tenant that owns this object. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `valid_seconds` (Number) Validity in seconds (up to 30 days). Defaults to 7 days. Only used at creation and not read back from Porch; changing it forces a new invitation (setting it after an import does not).

### Read-Only

- `consumed` (Boolean) Whether the invitation has been accepted.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Invitation ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_invite.grandma <tenant>/<invite_id>
```
